annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, exact multiword narrow-range gap, and strengthened equality and strictness comparison

assumptions: The input unit roundoff and both underflow scales are nonnegative.
The scaling threshold theta is positive.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P20 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P20 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p20_t3_multiword_narrow_range_gap {m n q p : Nat} (u U theta gmin Gmin : Real) (A : Fin m -> Fin n -> Real) (B : Fin n -> Fin q -> Real) ... : rangeFree <= narrowRange and narrowRange = rangeFree + inputUnderflow + accumUnderflow and (narrowRange = rangeFree iff inputUnderflow = 0 and accumUnderflow = 0) and ((0 < inputUnderflow or 0 < accumUnderflow) -> rangeFree < narrowRange)
formal_statement.plain_language: The multiword narrow-range envelope (4.32) is the range-free envelope (4.33) plus exactly two nonnegative underflow contributions, with exact equality and strictness criteria.

informal_proof: Expand the two paper-scoped coefficients. Their exact difference is the sum of the input and accumulation underflow terms. Rectangular infinity norms and both coefficients are nonnegative, giving the weak comparison; a sum of two nonnegative terms vanishes exactly when both vanish, and is positive when either is positive.
informal_statement: An exact strengthened certificate for the comparison of the multiword bounds (4.32) and (4.33).
